meta.purpose: Professional Portfolio Builder — every completed skill must produce a tangible artefact, documented to a consistent standard.
meta.standard: Three finished projects with full documentation outrank fifteen unfinished ones. Each artefact must state the business problem, the data, the method, the analysis, the results, the limitations and the recommendations.
meta.dataEthics: Use synthetic, anonymised or public data only. Never publish employer, client or personal data. State the data source and any masking applied.
organisation: By evidence type (model, dashboard, report, automation, case)

documentationTemplate.prompt: What decision was the work meant to support? Who is the audience?
Source, period, grain, volume, known quality issues, and what you excluded and why.
Approach, tools, assumptions, and the alternatives you rejected.
The computations and the reasoning, with the working shown or linked.
What the numbers show, with the three most important findings.
What the analysis cannot tell you, and where it could be wrong.
Specific actions, owners, timings and expected impact.
What you would do differently, and what you learned about your own judgement.

complexityLevels.name: Foundation
complexityLevels.description: A single-technique artefact with clear scope and a defensible answer.

complexityLevels.name: Applied
complexityLevels.description: A multi-step analysis with real trade-offs and a professional recommendation.

complexityLevels.name: Advanced
complexityLevels.description: A model or system that others could use, with documentation, validation and stated limitations.
